‘Reliable Sources Have Said Tinubu Is Undergoing Treatment In France’ – Sowore

African Action Congress (AAC) presidential candidate, Omoyele Sowore, has alleged that President Bola Tinubu is hospitalised and undergoing treatment in France. [6]

President Tinubu Returns to Nigeria After Working Visit to France

By Bello Wakili

President Bola Ahmed Tinubu has returned to Nigeria after a working visit to France. [1]

Air France to resume nonstop Manila–Paris flights in October after seasonal halt

Air France will resume its nonstop flights between Paris-Charles de Gaulle Airport (CDG) and Manila’s Ninoy Aquino International Airport (MNL) on October 19, 2026, ending a months-long seasonal suspension of the route. [4]

France warns against escalation of high school demonstrations

France's prime minister on Monday said any escalation of demonstrations at high schools would be "irresponsible", as a student protest movement spread to cities beyond the Paris region, a day ahead of a nationwide strike by public sector workers. [5]
